_comment: Ten labeled jobs for diagnosing the matcher. Labels + rationales were written by hand BEFORE the matcher was ever run on them, from the candidate profile below only. Label meanings: 'good' = a sensible person with this CV would want it surfaced near the top; 'poor' = should be ranked low or excluded; 'borderline' = reasonable people disagree (reported, not counted as right/wrong); 'unknown_jd' = no JD available, expected outcome is NEEDS_JD / provisional, never a hard reject. Ten items is a diagnostic aid, NOT statistical validation. Weights must not be tuned against these labels.

cv.content_text: Backend engineer, 4 years. Built Django REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL, containerised with Docker and deployed on AWS. Strong pytest and Git habits.

jobs.title: Backend Python Engineer
jobs.jd_text: Acme Cloud is hiring a Backend Python Engineer. You will build REST APIs with Python and Django on PostgreSQL. Requirements: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Git. 3+ years of experience. Nice to have: Docker, AWS. Fully remote within the UK. Full-time permanent.
jobs.label: good
jobs.rationale: Every required skill is in the CV, years requirement is below the candidate's 4, remote and full-time and salary above the minimum.

jobs.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs.jd_text: DataWorks seeks a Senior Python Developer for our London office (hybrid, 2 days in office). Requirements: Python, Django, AWS, Docker. 5+ years of experience. Preferred: Kubernetes. Full-time.
jobs.label: good
jobs.rationale: All required skills match and location/hybrid/full-time/salary fit; the 5-year ask is a one-year stretch, which is normal for a good application.

jobs.title: Frontend React Developer
jobs.jd_text: PixelForge needs a Frontend React Developer. Requirements: React, TypeScript, CSS, Webpack. 3+ years. Remote, full-time.
jobs.label: poor
jobs.rationale: Logistics fit perfectly but none of the required skills (React, TypeScript, CSS, Webpack) are on the CV.

jobs.title: Python Developer (Contract)
jobs.jd_text: FinServe needs a Python Developer on a 6-month contract, on-site in Manchester five days a week. Requirements: Python, Django, PostgreSQL. 3+ years.
jobs.label: poor
jobs.rationale: Skills match, but it is contract (candidate wants full-time), fully on-site, and in another city (candidate wants remote or hybrid in London).

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.jd_text: Insightly is hiring a Junior Data Analyst. Requirements: SQL, Excel, Tableau. Python is a plus. 0-1 years. Hybrid London, full-time.
jobs.label: poor
jobs.rationale: Salary of 32k is under the 45k minimum and the core skills (SQL/Excel/Tableau) barely overlap; it is a step down in seniority.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.jd_text: CloudNine is looking for a DevOps Engineer. Requirements: AWS, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Python scripting. 4+ years. Remote, full-time.
jobs.label: borderline
jobs.rationale: AWS, Docker and Python are shared, but Terraform and Kubernetes are missing and it is a different career track; reasonable people would split.

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.jd_text: ShadyStaffing Ltd has a Python Developer role. Requirements: Python, Django, PostgreSQL. 3+ years. Remote, full-time.
jobs.label: poor
jobs.rationale: Perfect on paper but the candidate has explicitly excluded this company; an exclusion rule must win over a good skills match.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.jd_text: Brightside needs a Full Stack Developer. Requirements: Python, Django, JavaScript, React. 3+ years. Remote, full-time.
jobs.label: borderline
jobs.rationale: Half of the required stack (Python, Django) is a match and half (JavaScript, React) is not; plausible stretch role.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd_text: NeuralWorks is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer. Requirements: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLOps. 5+ years. Master's degree preferred. Hybrid London, full-time.
jobs.label: poor
jobs.rationale: Only Python overlaps; PyTorch, TensorFlow and MLOps are the substance of the role and the candidate has no ML experience.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python)
jobs.snippet: Backend Engineer (Python) at Quill and Co, London. Apply: https://quill.example.com/jobs/backend
jobs.label: unknown_jd
jobs.rationale: Title and city fit but there is no description at all. The correct outcome is NEEDS_JD / a clearly-marked provisional score, never a rejection.
